definition_quote.value: a public health worker who applies an understanding of the experience, language and culture of the populations that the individual serves and who provides direct services aimed at optimizing individual and family health outcomes, including: (1) informal and motivational counseling and education; (2) interventions to maximize social supports; (3) care coordination; (4) facilitation of access to health care and social services; (5) health screenings; and (6) other services that the secretary defines by rule
